why: The scripts whose FIRST REAL RUN is the daily chain (RCA F2, design/RCA-holistic-2026-09-22.md). A push to main that changes one of them must carry a chain rehearsal verdict (ops/rehearse-chain.ps1) over data no older than max_data_age_days, or pre-push refuses it. -NoRehearsal on ops/push-main.ps1 (TC_NO_REHEARSAL for a plain git push) is the loud bypass.
outputs_note: Where the chain puts the board it is rehearsed over (the newest by its date decides freshness) and its own guard verdict. Declared here, the chain's contract, so the harness spells no other module's paths.
hooks_note: 2026-09-22 (post-landing review F4, plan-2026-09-22-10): only ops/hooks/pre-commit is here. The rehearsal installs the rehearsed tree's own pre-commit in its clone and makes the bot commit through it (stage 7), so a pre-commit edit is exactly what it exercises. It never runs commit-msg or pre-push, so the old ops/hooks/* glob demanded a rehearsal that could not reach the edit; ops/test-prepush-hook.ps1 is what proves those hooks.
exclude_note: Excluded even when a derive_from script names them, because their first real run is NOT the chain or a rehearsal cannot exercise them: the test suites and the gate run at push time already (test-auditors has its own pre-push leg), and the store pulls sit behind -NoPull. Measured 2026-09-22 over origin/main 09-19..09-22: without these, 72 of 193 non-bot commits touched the set, test-auditors.ps1 alone 15 of them.
derive_note: Every .ps1 NAMED in a derive_from script's text (its delegated audits, the libraries it dot-sources, the builders and lanes it launches) joins the set, resolved by file name under derive_dirs at the pushed commit. check-ad-cycles.ps1 is deliberately NOT a derive_from: it names about 150 advisory audits in its INSPECT fan-out, which run after the ship boundary and cannot hold the board or refuse the commit; deriving from it would ask a 14-minute rehearsal of nearly every push. Its own edits are rehearsed through files[].
